artifact: MGR FM3 Project 2 Critique and Reasoning Loop

critique_targets.name: Evidence Grounding
critique_targets.question: Does every factual reasoning item have traceable evidence?

critique_targets.name: Source Traceability
critique_targets.question: Can every evidence item be traced to its source record?

critique_targets.name: Known versus Inferred
critique_targets.question: Are observations clearly separated from inference?

critique_targets.name: Uncertainty
critique_targets.question: Are uncertainty and confidence limitations preserved?

critique_targets.name: Knowledge Gaps
critique_targets.question: Are missing evidence and unresolved questions explicitly recorded?

critique_targets.name: Contradictions
critique_targets.question: Are conflicting evidence signals preserved rather than hidden?

critique_targets.name: Unsupported Inference
critique_targets.question: Has any conclusion been introduced without sufficient evidence?

critique_targets.name: Human Review
critique_targets.question: Does the workflow route high-consequence reasoning to human review?
